Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026

1. File Processing

Online Converter processes all files (PDFs, images, documents) locally in your browser. Your files are never uploaded to any server. All conversion, compression, editing, and optimization happens on your device using client-side technologies (WebAssembly, Web Workers, Canvas).

2. Data We Collect

We do not collect, store, or transmit your files. We may collect anonymous usage analytics (page views, tool usage counts) to improve the service. No personal data or file content is collected.

3. Cookies & Advertising

Online Converter may display advertisements (including Google AdSense). Third-party advertisers may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits. You can opt out of personalized advertising via Google Ads Settings or NAI opt-out.

4. Local Storage

We use browser localStorage to save your theme preference, language choice, and recent tools. This data stays on your device and is never transmitted.

5. Third-Party Libraries

We load open-source libraries (pdf-lib, pdf.js, JSZip, FileSaver, gifenc, tesseract.js) from CDNs (jsDelivr/unpkg). These CDNs may log standard request metadata (IP address) per their own privacy policies.

6. Children's Privacy

Online Converter is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

7. Changes

We may update this policy. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date.

8. Contact

Questions? Email support@filofa.com.
